 Tulane vs. Charlotte prediction, odds: Week 9 college football Friday picks by advanced model
 The SportsLine Projection Model has revealed its best bets for the Friday matchup between the Tulane Green Wave and Charlotte 49ers
 By
 Adam Thompson 
 Oct 30, 2026
 at
 5:10 pm ET 
 •
 2 min read
 Imagn Images 
 American Athletic Conference teams looking to find their form face off on Friday night as the Charlotte 49ers host the Tulane Green Wave. Charlotte (1-6, 1-2 AAC) just won its first game, a 38-31 road win over Temple. Tulane (3-4, 1-2) was rocked last week by AAC powerhouse UTSA but still has strong bowl hopes heading into the final month of the regular season.  Kickoff is set for 7 p.m. ET from Jerry Richardson Stadium in Charlotte, N.C. The latest Tulane vs. Charlotte odds list the Green Wave as 8.5-point favorites, while the over/under is 47.5. The Green Wave are at -345 on the money line (risk $345 to win $100).  Top Tulane vs. Charlotte predictions
 After simulating Charlotte vs. Tulane 10,000 times, SportsLine model is going Over 47.5 points at  betting apps .  Tulane's offense ranks near the bottom of FBS, managing just 20.3 points per game. But it does have a rushing attack, with Johnnie Daniels (394 yards, 6.0 per carry) and Maurice Turner (315, 8.5) moving the ball. Red zone issues and turnovers have sabotaged those efforts. 
 But neither team has a defense to lean on. The Green Wave are allowing 417 yards per game. They're coming off a 42-19 to UTSA after a win over Memphis, though they did force six turnovers the prior week in a win over Memphis. Charlotte possesses one of the nation's worst defenses, giving up a whopping 40.6 ppg. QB Cole Gonzales has thrown for 802 yards but with 7 INTs; the 49ers are coming off a 38-31 road win over Temple after several blowout losses. The Over has hit in three straight 49ers games. 
 This time around, SportsLine's model is projecting 49 combined points, making the Over the value 56% of the time. See the model's spread and money-line picks at SportsLine .
